_comment: Two-task example: a 'low' priority task that runs continuously and a 'high' priority task that wakes up every 5ms for a short burst. With SCHED_OTHER and `priority` values (rt-app: lower number = higher priority), scxsim treats both as fair-class but the per-task wake-up cadence creates a clear interleaving on the Perfetto timeline. Useful for observing wake-up + preemption behaviour with the bare minimum of moving parts (compare hello.json which has only one task).
_run_units: rt-app 'run'/'sleep' are microseconds; priority is the rt-app nice-like field (lower = more eager).
